QuestInfo.name: New Heart
QuestInfo.0: Humanoid A has stopped moving after giving its Mechanical Heart to Neo Huroid. Can Dr. De Lang make Humanoid A operable again? Go see Dr. De Lang.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. De Lang has agreed to temporarily repair #r#t4009077##k and #r#t4033910##k to make a transplant to Humanoid A.
QuestInfo.2: You've delivered the material needed by Dr. De Lang to make the new heart.

0.0: Humanoid A transplanted its heart into a Neo Huroid? That fool... Well, it kept mentioning how it wanted to be more human, so I suppose I can understand...
0.1: But it's still too early for Humanoid A to become human! It was going off about being a parent, but it didn't consider my feelings! I'M its parent!

yes.0: Humanoid A's mechanical heart is my masterpiece. My heart and soul went into making that thing, so it'll probably take me another year or so to make a new one. But I can't wait that long.
yes.1: I need to transplant a temporary heart for now. The specs won't be as good, but I need Humanoid A back online. Could you bring me #r35 #t4009077##k items and #r1 #t4033910##k?

no.0: I need to restart Humanoid A first.

1.0: Did you bring all the materials? Yeah, this heart won't be NEARLY as good. I'm not sure if it'll even last a year. But this is a temporary measure... Hold on a second.

default.0: I need to restart Humanoid A, even with a temporary mechanical heart.
